text: Being here, I feel a sense of anticipation and curiosity. In the first image, I'm on the threshold of an event or seminar, watching people engaged in learning or discussion—reminding me of the collective pursuit of knowledge. The second image brings me into a space celebrating research and innovation; the vibrant colors and interactive displays spark my excitement to explore ideas and the endless possibilities of human creativity. There is a hum of discovery everywhere, and I feel invigorated by the exchange of intellect and imagination.
